paragraphs.text: In the modern age of Dominaria , the continental plate under the former Terisian island of Argoth is completely shattered. Because of this, there's a north-south deep-sea trench that runs almost from the Terisian Isles to Sarpadia in the south.
Because of the Homarids living within the trench, it forms a nasty north-south divide in the Dominarian waters that's probably a real challenge for merfolk to pass through safely.
The Old Voda Sea part of the trench includes Dromar's Cavern , an ancient merfolk crypt which once housed the blue primeval , Dromar .

The trench expanded from the Old Voda Sea to the Terisian Isles in the wake of the Sylex Blast , forming a cold-water habitat for the homarids to thrive in. After about a century of breeding, the homarids rose from the trench and invaded the Vodalian empire, forcing the merfolk to flee before them. During the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires , Galina and her court had to resort to a portal to transport the remnants of her empire away from the homarid-infested waters.
